name: Verify low-confidence classification leaves fields for manual triage
objective: Validate that when the AI has low confidence in classification, Category/Subcategory remain blank or are flagged for manual triage.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and describe an ambiguous issue spanning multiple categories
steps.testData: "Something is wrong with my system, not sure if it's hardware or software"
steps.expectedResult: The assistant processes the issue with low classification confidence

steps.description: Complete the ticket creation flow and confirm
Open the created ticket record and check classification fields
steps.expectedResult: Category and Subcategory are blank or flagged for manual triage
